products.excerpt: Get your announcement written (optional) and distributed to 350+ news and finance sites so it is findable by people and Google. Four packages, $239.99–$719.99. Placement, not guaranteed journalist coverage.
products.content:
You have news — a launch, a hire, a milestone, a raise. We get that story onto a network of real news and finance sites so it shows up when people and search engines look for you.

Packages

  • You Write It — $239.99 — you supply the release; we distribute to 350+ news sites
  • We Write It — $299.99 — we write ~500 words, then distribute
  • Research & Write — $399.99 — researched writing plus 350+ news distribution
  • Recommended — $719.99 — we write it, plus 350+ news and USA Today, Benzinga, and Barchart

What you get

  • A distributed press release on eligible outlets in your package
  • A written release (on the writing tiers), around 500 words, in standard news format
  • A links report showing where it landed

How it works

  1. Pick a package and buy.
  2. At checkout, send your announcement details (or the finished release) and a contact handle.
  3. We finalise the release, distribute it, and send you the report of live links.

Who it is for

Companies and founders with genuine, newsworthy announcements who want durable, findable coverage and syndication.

What this is not

Not guaranteed journalist pickup, rankings, or sales. Distribution places your announcement on syndication outlets; whether a reporter covers it depends on the news itself.

FAQ

What separates the tiers? Whether we write it, how much research goes in, and whether premium finance outlets are included.

How long until it is live? Usually a few business days from final approval.

Do the links stay up? Syndicated news links are generally durable; we send the full list.

products.content:

Packages

  • Burst (recommended) — $1,297.99 — 3 plays
  • Campaign — $1,997.99 — 6 plays
  • Marquee — $3,397.99 — 12 plays

How it works

  1. Pick a package and buy.
  2. At checkout, send a link to your 15-second video (Dropbox, Drive, or similar) and a contact handle.
  3. We book the slot, confirm the run date, and send proof of play afterward.

Who it is for

Brands, launches, and announcements that want a real-world moment for social content, press, or investor updates — where the value is the footage and the story, not foot traffic.

What this is not

Not a performance ad. It will not be measured in clicks or sales. Buy it for the asset and the credibility, and plan how you will use the footage.

FAQ

What format should the video be? 15 seconds, high resolution, in the ratio we confirm for the screen. We will tell you if it needs adjusting.

Which screen and when? Confirmed after purchase based on availability.

Do I get proof? Yes, where the screen operator supplies it — usually a photo or short clip of your spot running.

products.excerpt: Case assessment and response help for Airbnb reviews that may violate Airbnb’s review policy. Documented request, drafted response, honest read on your odds. Not a guaranteed removal.
products.content:
If an Airbnb review of your listing is retaliatory, contains false claims, or breaks Airbnb’s review policy, this service assesses the case and helps you respond and escalate correctly.

What you get

  • An assessment of each review against Airbnb’s content and review policies (extortion, irrelevant content, bias, safety claims that are not true)
  • A documented removal request for anything that qualifies, prepared the way Airbnb’s support flow expects
  • A drafted public response for reviews that will remain
  • Notes on preventing the same pattern with future guests

How it works

  1. Buy the service. At checkout, send the listing URL, the review in question, and a contact handle.
  2. We tell you honestly whether the review has a policy basis for removal.
  3. We prepare the request and the response draft; you send and approve.

Who it is for

Hosts facing reviews that appear to violate Airbnb policy — not hosts trying to hide accurate guest feedback.

What this is not

Not a guaranteed removal. Airbnb makes the decision. This is a correctly built case plus response drafting and follow-up.

products.excerpt: Policy-based help with Google reviews that may violate Google’s content rules: per-review assessment, documented flags, drafted responses. Package by volume. Not a removal service — Google decides.
products.content:
If a Google review of your business looks fake, is off-topic, contains a conflict of interest, or breaks Google’s review policies, this service assesses each one and puts a proper case in front of Google.

What you get

  • A review-by-review assessment against Google’s published content policies
  • A documented flag for each review that qualifies, organised the way Google’s flow expects
  • Drafted, calm public responses for the reviews that will stay up
  • Package options sized to how many reviews you are dealing with

How it works

  1. Choose a package and buy.
  2. At checkout, send your Google Business Profile or Maps URL and a contact handle.
  3. We assess the reviews and tell you which have a real policy basis. We flag those and draft responses; you approve.

Who it is for

Businesses facing reviews that appear to break Google’s rules — fake experiences, competitor attacks, off-topic rants — not businesses trying to bury honest criticism.

What this is not

Not a guaranteed removal. Google alone decides, and honest negative reviews stay up. This is assessment, correct flagging, and response drafting.

FAQ

How long does Google take? Days to weeks, and sometimes a flag is rejected and re-filed. We follow up and keep you posted.

What if a review is negative but true? It stays. We say so up front and focus on a strong response plus more real reviews.

Do you need my Google account? No. Flags and responses go through the public profile tools.

products.excerpt: Structured help getting an eligible website or domain unblocked by Meta on Facebook and Instagram. We assess viability first, submit the review through the right channel, and keep you updated. Not a guarantee — Meta decides.
products.content:
Meta sometimes blocks a website or domain from being shared on Facebook and Instagram — in DMs, posts, bios, and ads. If your link opens a warning screen or silently fails to post, this is the structured way to ask Meta to review it and lift the block.

What you get

  • An eligibility check on your domain and the block type (spam flag, security flag, policy strike, or a shared-hosting neighbour issue)
  • The review request submitted through the correct Meta channel for your case
  • Email updates at each step until Meta responds
  • A short list of what to change so it is less likely to be re-flagged

How it works

  1. Buy the service. At checkout, give us the exact URL that is blocked and a contact handle (WhatsApp, Telegram, or email).
  2. We assess whether the case is viable before we submit anything. If we do not think it will succeed, we tell you plainly and you decide whether to proceed.
  3. We submit the review and keep you posted by email until there is a decision.

Who it is for

Businesses and creators whose real, policy-compliant site has been blocked or “marked as spam” on Meta — not sites trying to get around a legitimate ban.

What this is not

Not a guarantee and not a backdoor. Meta makes the final call and can decline or take weeks. This is a correctly prepared, correctly routed review request plus follow-up. If the domain was blocked for genuine policy violations, fix those first.

FAQ

How long does it take? Meta’s review can run from a few days to a few weeks. We chase it and update you; we cannot set their timeline.

What if it stays blocked? Some cases do not succeed — Meta’s decision is final. We will tell you honestly if we think a case is weak before submitting.

Do you need my Facebook login? No. The review goes through public Meta channels. Never put a password in a form.

Which platforms? Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and others — tell us where your content lives.

Will this make me go viral? No one can promise that. This raises the floor on how a post looks; the ceiling is your content.

Packages

  • Growth — $199.99 — a steadier campaign for growing businesses
  • Pro — $499.99 — a stronger mix for competitive keywords

  • Monthly authority-building appropriate to the tier — placements, mentions, and digital PR at the higher tiers

  • A monthly report of what was placed

  1. Pick a tier and buy.
  2. At checkout, tell us the pages and keywords you want to move and your site URL.
  3. We map the campaign, run it monthly, and report what was placed.

Who it is for

Sites with a working page and a real offer that need off-page signals to catch up — not sites hoping SEO will fix a broken page or a weak offer.

What this is not

  • Not a “#1 tomorrow” promise
  • Not a black-hat spam campaign
  • Not a replacement for a broken website or weak offer

Which tier should I pick? Match it to how competitive your keywords are, or run the 1-minute SEO guide for a suggestion.

How soon do I see movement? Off-page SEO compounds over months, not days. Give it a full quarter to read the trend.

products.excerpt: Post-allowance Instagram growth: you publish within a weekly allowance, we drive discovery engagement on those posts plus background follower growth. Three tiers. Ranges are honest expectations, not guarantees.

  1. Pick a tier and subscribe.
  2. Post within your weekly allowance; send the links or connect the profile at intake.
  3. We run discovery engagement on those posts plus the background growth package; you watch it in Insights.

Who it is for

Creators and brands who post consistently and want more discovery on that content — not accounts looking to buy a follower number with nothing behind it.

What this is not

We do not claim “100% real U.S. humans,” guaranteed Explore placement, or permanent rankings. The ranges shown are honest expectations for a typical month when you post within your allowance; results still vary by niche, content quality, and account health.

FAQ

Do I have to post? Yes. The system works on the posts you publish.

Are the comments real? Yes, and they relate to your post. Growth and Elite add US/EU and verified commenters.

Can I cancel? Yes, month to month.

Businesses running up to about $5,000/mo across multiple channels that want one managed program instead of juggling platforms.

What this is not

Not media spend, and not a performance guarantee. You pay platforms directly. Above $5,000/mo total, we switch you to a custom rate.

FAQ

Do you really run all those networks? Networks with an approved API are automated; the rest are handled as AI drafts you or we launch manually. Status is always visible.

Is ad spend included? No. $499/mo is creative and management; the ad budget is yours, paid to each platform.

What if I go over $5,000/mo? We move you to a custom quote — just ask.
